ValidationRule.description: Each record can only have a value for Segment OR Subsegment
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Deal_Level__c , "3")), OR(
AND( ISBLANK(TEXT(Account_Segment__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Account_SubSegment__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Primary_Product_Line__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Billing_Country__c)) ),
AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account_Segment__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account_SubSegment__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Primary_Product_Line__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Billing_Country__c))) ),
AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account_Segment__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account_SubSegment__c))) ),
AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Primary_Product_Line__c))), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account_Segment__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account_SubSegment__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Billing_Country__c))) ) ),
AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Billing_Country__c))), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account_Segment__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account_SubSegment__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Primary_Product_Line__c))) ) )
) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please specify a value for Primary Product Line or Billing Country or Account Segment and/or Account SubSegment. All 4 fields cannot be populated at once.
